mentions.name: Team-scoped blackboard for agents
mentions.description: An experimental team, project, and task-scoped blackboard tool for AI agents, letting multiple users’ agents — for example different developers working on different sides of the same fix or feature — share context in one workspace.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m also experimenting with a team / project / task-scoped blackboard (https://martinfowler.com/articles/exploring-gen-ai/an-accidental-blackboard.html) tool for agents, to be used by multiple users’ agents (eg different devs working on different sides of the same fix or feature)
mentions.author: ElFitz
